description: Bounded OData CSDL schema inspection for PA DHS childcare; entity and pagination requests are disabled.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects; GET https://data.pa.gov/api/odata/v4/$metadata is the only permitted request.
retry: No retries or API fallback; failure requires inspection.
checkpoint: Persist only a complete validated selected-schema receipt; exclude other datasets and raw XML.
idempotency: New immutable receipt for each explicit successful invocation; no current pointer changes.
cancellation: Abort transport and bounded body reading cooperatively; remove only an owned unpublished temporary receipt.
retention_profile: Internal selected CSDL field/type/nullability/key metadata and response digest only.
